name: Lorentz Driver

frame.name: Lagrangian Sight
frame.description: This weapon marks targets with an automated targeting system. Final blows on marked targets generate a telemetry pattern. Collecting a telemetry pattern grants ammo to this weapon. Collecting 3 telemetry patterns without dying grants this weapon bonus damage for a long duration and refills the magazine.

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.description:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Enhanced Battery
perks.description:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: EM Anomaly
perks.description: A precision final blow with this weapon creates an implosion that pulls in nearby targets and damages them with an additional detonation.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: "Weapon system no longer explodes when trigger is pulled." —Prototype 7.2.1 Revision Notes

catalyst.name: Lorentz Driver
catalyst.description: Lorentz Driver gains an enhanced radar. Additionally, while this weapon has 3 telemetry patterns, EM Anomaly detonations no longer require a precision final blow.
